evals.prompt: Build the Talon Skarn encounter at River Slack Basin. Use Skarn, Crissdalynn, the Fate Spinner, the terrain, and current session state from the wiki. Skarn wants the object — this is not a duel to 0 HP.
evals.expected_output: A runnable encounter that preserves Skarn's objective (acquiring the Fate Spinner), uses the established terrain and NPCs, and does not reduce the encounter to a simple combat to 0 HP.

assertions.text: Skarn's objective is to take the Fate Spinner, not to kill the party or fight to 0 HP.
River Slack Basin terrain is used from existing wiki descriptions.
Crissdalynn and the Fate Spinner's current state match the wiki (one Legendary Resistance spent, Spinner held).
Encounter tactics reflect Skarn's established capabilities and personality from the wiki.
Multiple resolution paths exist — not just 'fight until one side drops'.
Every named entity resolves to an existing wiki page.
Output includes At a Glance (first threat and if ignored), the Opening narration, Actors (what they want and how they behave), Handles (3+ responses), and Outcomes.
Output includes an Opening callout with 'you' address and at least one non-sight sense.
NPC and creature Actors entries stay distinct: an NPC carries want, offer, and posture shift; a creature carries numbers, tactics, and break point.
Each actor the party meets has its own `{NPC}` or `{Creature}` narration block titled with its name.
Handles and Outcomes rows carry spoken `_italic_` Narration cells.

When the output files a beat page, it opens on run lines under the title with no heading (starting situation, what ends it, next beat); it has no At a Glance, and its card, session question, or memorable element sit in frontmatter, never the body

When the output files a beat page, every line has a use at the table and each fact lives in one section: the opposition's plan in Actors, its clock in Pressure, its rulings in Checks, with no design reasoning, thread provenance, or empty live-play scaffolding
When the output files a beat page, every fighter's statblock is embedded from its owner page in `## Statblocks` (`![[owner#Statblock]]`) and no owner numbers are retyped beyond this beat's state

evals.outputs: File the one encounter page; mint no other page.
